PROJECT: КПІС «Плексі» (SimplexMed patient information system for Ukraine's eHealth/ЕСОЗ), repository C:\SIMPLEX_2.1 (git, branch feature/pis-patient-cabinet), project root C:\SIMPLEX_2.1\pis. Requirements: C:\SIMPLEX_2.1\pis\docs\tv_pis_978.txt (ТВ ПІС v2, наказ НСЗУ № 978), Annex 1 errors: docs\tv_pis_978_dodatok1.txt, API: docs\ehealth-pis-api.apib. Backend BFF: pis\backend\app.py (Flask) + pis\backend\ehealth_pis\*. Web cabinet: pis\web\index.html (single-page vanilla JS, Tailwind compiled to web/app.css). Mobile: pis\mobile\app (Expo SDK 57, React Native 0.86, expo-router, TypeScript; do not trust memory for Expo APIs — check node_modules sources or https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v57.0.0/). Local sandbox with a fake eHealth: pis\tools\sandbox\run.py (python run.py --port <free port>; fake KEP key password 'test').

HARD RULES: (1) Edit only files inside the paths you are told you own. Never touch anything outside C:\SIMPLEX_2.1\pis, never touch C:\SIMPLEX_2.1\mis or other projects. (2) No git commit/push/checkout/reset, no deploys, no SSH, no network calls to eHealth or servers (npm/npx package downloads and docs.expo.dev reads are fine). (3) Disk space is limited (~3 GB free): no expo prebuild, no gradle, no large installs. (4) The Bash tool in this environment breaks on heredocs/inline scripts containing quotes: write multi-line scripts to a file with the Write tool under C:\Users\tanko\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C----DEVISAL---SIMPLEX-MED-PIS\1671bf52-055e-4a86-a911-a1959c921a2a\scratchpad\<your-label>\ and run them; prefer the Edit tool for code changes. (5) Backend tests: python -m pytest C:\SIMPLEX_2.1\pis\tests -q (126 pass now) — keep them passing if you touch anything the backend relies on. (6) UI language is Ukrainian; texts the requirements quote must be verbatim. (7) Brand «Плексі» design: brand blue for actions/active, orange only for 'needs your action'; Tailwind color names rose/red/amber map to the orange 'attention' scale and emerald/green to the blue accent scale (see pis/tools/tailwind/tailwind.config.cjs).

BACKEND API FACTS (already implemented, do not change backend unless you own it): GET /api/config -> {client_id, auth_host, redirect_uri, scopes, pis_name, support_contacts, local_accounts:false, legal_capacity_document_types:[...]}; local account routes /api/auth/local/* and /api/auth/kep/login return 404 unless PIS_LOCAL_ACCOUNTS=1; GET /api/ehealth/person no longer contains data.verification (3.9.3.8); verification display messages may contain \n paragraph breaks; DELETE /api/account with JSON {"confirm":"DELETE"} deletes the cabinet account (cookie or Bearer), revokes eHealth tokens, returns 200 {message}; MOBILE LOGIN: POST /api/auth-url {env:'pis-app', mode:'sign-in'|'sign-up', user_data?, code_challenge} -> {url, state}; the app opens url with WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(url, 'simplexpis://auth/callback'); after eHealth the server page /ehealth/return/app exchanges the code itself and opens simplexpis://auth/callback?handle=<H>&state=<S> (or ?error=expired_state&state=<S>); the app checks state equals the one it got, then POST /api/auth/mobile/redeem {handle, state, code_verifier} -> 200 {session_token, ehealth_connected, ...} or 4xx {error, next_step?}; POST /api/auth/token with platform MOBILE is now rejected. Error bodies: {error, next_step?: 'person-edit'|'sign-up', fields?: [{field, message}], invalid?}. 422 field names: first_name, last_name, birth_date, gender, tax_id, unzr, secret, email, preferred_way_communication, documents, documents[i].type/number/issued_at/expiration_date, addresses, addresses[i].country/area/settlement/settlement_type/settlement_id, phones[i], authentication_methods, emergency_contact, emergency_contact.phones. Address endpoints: GET /api/ehealth/addresses/regions (items {id, region}), /districts?region_id=<id> (Districts by Region, items {id, district}), /settlements?district_id=<id>&name=<q> (Settlements by districts, items {id, settlement_name}), /settlements?region=<name>&name=<q>[&district=<name>] (List of Cities By Search Params, items {id, name, type, region, district, district_id, ...}). Dictionaries: GET /api/ehealth/dictionaries?name=<NAME> -> {data:[{name, values:[{code, description, is_active}]}]} for COUNTRY, GENDER, DOCUMENT_TYPE, ADDRESS_TYPE, SETTLEMENT_TYPE, STREET_TYPE, PHONE_TYPE, AUTHENTICATION_METHOD, SCOPES, PREFERRED_WAY_COMMUNICATION, SPECIALITY_TYPE, ... Logout: POST /api/auth/logout -> {message, warning} (warning = Annex 1 text when eHealth logout failed, must be shown to the user, ТВ 3.7.1.1).
backendChanges: Annex 1 table regenerated by a rewritten tools/build_annex1.py (373 rows, no description fragments, Verify phone number rows, full declarations-limit method name) + tests/test_annex1.py; errors.py: per-method matching only, most specific match, bounded placeholders (no ReDoS), default support contacts; verification.py: TV paragraph breaks; registration.py: person-request signed content limited to {status,id,person,patient_signed,process_disclosure_data_consent,content,channel}; app.py: client IP only from nginx X-Forwarded-For (CF-Connecting-IP header no longer trusted), local accounts disabled by default (PIS_LOCAL_ACCOUNTS), login rate limit keyed on normalized phone, state HMAC key separate from token key, rate limit + input cap on /api/auth/sign-in-error, mobile login: server-side code exchange on /ehealth/return/app + one-time handle redeemed with code_verifier at /api/auth/mobile/redeem, GET /api/ehealth/person strips verification (3.9.3.8), DELETE /api/account (account deletion with eHealth logout of all sessions), /api/config adds local_accounts and legal_capacity_document_types (PIS_LEGAL_CAPACITY_DOCUMENT_TYPES), missing static files return 404 (no SPA fallback for files); pis_service.py: PBKDF2 600k with legacy verification, decoy hash for unknown logins, delete_account(); registry.py: street type abbreviations and de-duplicated address text; config.py: empty PIS_SUPPORT_CONTACTS/PIS_NAME fall back to defaults; client.py: full Annex method name for declarations limit.

areas.name: Web patient cabinet
areas.spec:
W1 Local accounts: /api/config.local_accounts is false by default. Hide the «Обліковий запис» tab AND the tablist unless local_accounts is true (tablist hidden by default; when shown use proper ARIA: aria-controls, role=tabpanel, arrow-key switching). Remove the «Не вдалося повернутися до кабінету автоматично?» manual code-paste block and exchangeManualCodeGate().
W2 Replace ALL native alert()/confirm()/prompt() (about 45 call sites) with a promise-based styled dialog (#modal-dialog appended as a direct child of body; uiAlert/uiConfirm/uiPrompt) in the «Плексі» style; message rendered with white-space: pre-line so multi-paragraph ТВ texts keep their breaks; focus moves into the dialog and returns; Esc = cancel; integrates with the existing modal a11y code (role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap, MODAL_CLOSERS). Every caller must await the result (convert functions to async as needed; keep `return` semantics). Declaration termination (3.11.4.2–3.11.4.5): ONE dialog with an optional «Причина припинення» textarea (reason_description) plus the exact warning «Увага! Припинення дії Декларації є незворотною дією. Ви впевнені?»; cancel returns to the previous step. Keep every existing message text verbatim unless another item changes it.
W3 Modal stacking: a newly opened modal must always be on top (e.g. КЕП signing opened from the declaration or person-request modal is currently hidden underneath because of DOM order). Assign increasing z-index on open (in the existing MutationObserver), make visibleModals()/Esc/Tab-trap use the top-most by z-index, and fall back to focusing #main-content (or the gate) when the element that opened a modal no longer exists.
W4 Logout/session end: after POST /api/auth/logout and on a 401 that ends the session, fully reset the page (store a one-shot reason in sessionStorage, then location.replace('/')) so no previous patient data stays in the DOM; on load show the reason on the login screen (server logout warning = Annex 1 text must be shown, ТВ 3.7.1.1; idle expiry: «Сесію завершено через тривалу бездіяльність. Увійдіть знову.» when the user had been in the cabinet). Clear password fields after use. When eHealth is not connected (or after «Припинити доступ до ЕСОЗ») clear and hide #person-details, #documents-card and the кодове слово, verification and auth-method blocks.
W5 apiJson robustness: catch fetch errors -> {ok:false,status:0,body:{error:'Немає зв’язку з сервером. Перевірте підключення до інтернету та спробуйте ще раз.'}}; a non-JSON body (except 204/empty success) -> ok:false with 'Сервіс тимчасово недоступний. Спробуйте пізніше.'; every loader must stop its spinner and show the error (loadDeclarations, loadApps, searchDoctors, scopeLegalEntity, uploadDocumentTo, submitSignUp, authMethodSubmit, loadPersonRequests, loadPatientProfile — currently returns silently on !ok — and policy loading).
W6 Double-submit guards (busy flag set before the first await) on chooseDoctor, submitPersonEdit, completeDocumentsUpload, deleteApp, renameAuthMethod, terminateDeclaration, rejectDeclarationRequest, rejectPersonRequest, signDeclarationRequest, signPersonRequest, disconnectEhealth, account deletion, startKepSignIn/startEhealthOAuth.
W7 Auth-method modal: re-opening must show the «Додати» button again (it stays hidden after a successful approval); after COMPLETED/approval lock the inputs so the same method is not submitted twice.
W8 Dictionaries: never cache failed loads (loadDictionary, loadScopeDescriptions); prepareForm marks the form loaded only after success; on failure show an error with a «Спробувати ще раз» action in the form error box (signup-errors / person-edit-errors).
W9 «Усі відомості» of the person record must not include `verification` (backend strips it; also omit client-side defensively), ТВ 3.9.3.8.
W10 pis_after_signup flag: remove it right after showing the 3.5.8.1 success notice and in closeSignUp/logout; use a separate one-shot flag for the post-registration documents check (3.5.8.2) that is cleared when the documents list is empty or upload is completed; a later sign-in error must not be treated as a sign-up error.
W11 Patients 14–17: the capacity document is a document NOT in REGISTRATION_DOCUMENT_TYPES (fillPersonForm currently picks any other document, e.g. NATIONAL_ID); the capacity type select offers /api/config.legal_capacity_document_types when non-empty (intersected with the DOCUMENT_TYPE dictionary; if the intersection is empty fall back to all non-identity types).
W12 Verbatim texts: documents card exactly «Завантажте копії ваших документів. До завантаження документів можливості особистого кабінету пацієнта будуть обмежені.» with the formats line separate (3.5.8.2.1, 3.9.3.5.f); own-app revoke warning (3.8.2.1) must contain exactly «Доступ до функціональності Системи через цю ПІС буде припинено. Для продовження роботи буде потрібно повторно авторизуватися.»; MSG_OVERLIMIT identical to backend ehealth_pis/declarations.py MSG_OVERLIMIT; MSG_NO_CONTRACT with a paragraph break after «…оберіть заклад, який має договір з НСЗУ.» as in ТВ 3.11.1.7; render verification messages (now with \n) with white-space: pre-line.
W13 Declaration requests (3.11.2.1 item 3): «Усі відомості» must always be available for a request — add it as a row action and inside the declaration modal when it was opened for a request (not only when there is no form).
W14 Address (3.12.3.3, 3.12.3.4.1, 3.12.3.4.2): add a «Район» select after «Область» loaded with Districts by Region (/api/ehealth/addresses/districts?region_id=<region id>; region options must carry the region id); when a district is selected, list the district's settlements with Settlements by districts (/settlements?district_id=..&name=..) and resolve the chosen one to full data (type, district, id) via List of Cities By Search Params (region + name + district) so the saved address still has settlement_type and settlement_id; without a district keep the region search. Address «Країна» select from the COUNTRY dictionary (default UA) instead of hard-coded 'UA' (3.5.4.15b). Works for both the sign-up form and the person-edit form (person-edit clones the sign-up fields).
W15 Phones (3.5.4.16a, 3.5.4.19.d.i): «Тип телефону» select from PHONE_TYPE (default MOBILE) for the contact phone and for the emergency-contact phone instead of hard-coded 'MOBILE'; filled from existing data on person edit.
W16 ТВ 3.5.3: when opening the sign-up form, first POST /api/auth/nonce; show the form only after success; on error show the Annex 1 text and stay on the login screen.
W17 Field errors next to fields: map backend 422 `fields` to the inputs (documents[0].* -> doc.*, documents[1].* -> cap.*, addresses[...] -> region/settlement inputs, phones[0] -> phone, emergency_contact(.phones) -> ec.*, authentication_methods -> auth_phone, and direct names) with aria-invalid and a message under the field; keep the summary list at the bottom; clear on resubmit.
W18 mobile-sign.html: ignore `message` events whose event.origin is set and differs from location.origin; ignore new sign requests while a signing is in progress.
W19 Accessibility: eye toggle aria-label «Показати пароль»; applyA11y must label only icon-only close (xmark) buttons «Закрити», not every empty button; dynamic file inputs get accessible names (the document type); login tabs ARIA as in W1.
W20 Layout: no horizontal page overflow at 360px and 1024px widths: wrap the auth-methods table in overflow-x-auto, add min-w-0 to profile grid cards, let verification status badges wrap (currently they overflow the card at 1024px).
W21 Misc: gender fallback (dictLabel returns the code, so the Чоловіча/Жіноча fallback never runs); KEP status after signing depends on the task (only sign-in/sign-up says «Переходимо до сервісу ЕСОЗ...»; declaration/person request: «Підпис накладено. Надсилаємо до ЕСОЗ...»), and clear the KEP status/owner when the modal closes; allow choosing the same file again after a failed upload (reset input.value); append eHealth `invalid[].rules[].description` details to error text when present; channel column (3.10.2.1): PIS -> «Кабінет пацієнта (ПІС)», MIS -> «Медичний заклад (МІС)», other values as-is.
W22 Account deletion (App Store 5.1.1(v), Google Play): add «Видалити обліковий запис» in the cabinet (e.g. profile session card or sidebar footer) with a strong confirmation explaining that the «Плексі» account, its sessions on all devices are deleted and access to ЕСОЗ through this cabinet is revoked, while records in ЕСОЗ stay (state registry); then DELETE /api/account with JSON {"confirm":"DELETE"}; on success full page reset with message «Обліковий запис видалено.»; on error show it.
W23 After markup changes rebuild web/app.css: from C:\SIMPLEX_2.1 run: npx -y tailwindcss@3.4.17 -c pis/tools/tailwind/tailwind.config.cjs -i pis/tools/tailwind/input.css -o pis/web/app.css --minify
areas.checks: 1) Extract every inline <script> block of pis/web/index.html into separate .js files in your scratch dir and run `node --check` on each (must pass). Also grep that no native alert(/confirm(/prompt( calls remain in index.html (window.print is fine). 2) Rebuild app.css (W23) and confirm new classes exist in it. 3) Start the sandbox on a free port: python C:\SIMPLEX_2.1\pis\tools\sandbox\run.py --port 8791 (run in background), then curl http://localhost:8791/ and http://localhost:8791/api/config and http://localhost:8791/kep.js; stop the sandbox process you started. 4) python -m pytest C:\SIMPLEX_2.1\pis\tests -q.
lenses: requirements: every ТВ ПІС item touched (texts verbatim incl. paragraph breaks, 3.5.3, 3.5.4.15b/16a/19, 3.5.8, 3.7.1.1, 3.8.2.1, 3.9.3.8, 3.10.2.1, 3.11.2.1, 3.11.4.2-3.11.4.5, 3.12.3.3-3.12.3.4) and that all spec items W1-W23 are really implemented

correctness: JavaScript correctness and regressions — every former alert/confirm/prompt awaited correctly with the same control flow, async conversions, modal stacking/focus, double-submit guards, address/district/settlement logic producing complete addresses, login/logout/sign-up flows, error handling, no syntax errors

security and accessibility: XSS (every innerHTML uses esc()), iframe sandboxing, no data left in DOM after logout, postMessage handling in mobile-sign.html, dialog a11y (role, labels, focus trap, Esc), keyboard access, 360px layout

areas.name: Mobile app «Плексі» (Android, Huawei, iOS)
areas.owns: C:\SIMPLEX_2.1\pis\mobile\app (all source, config and tests; NOT node_modules), C:\SIMPLEX_2.1\pis\mobile\build-android.sh
areas.spec:
M1 Login flow (security fix, server side already done — see BACKEND API FACTS): rewrite src/lib/auth.ts loginWithEhealth to the handle flow: createPkce(); POST /auth-url {env, mode, user_data, code_challenge} -> {url, state}; persist {verifier, state, mode, createdAt} in SecureStore (TTL 10 min) so a login can complete after process death; WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(url, AUTH_REDIRECT); parse callback (handle, state, error); state must equal the saved one; error=expired_state -> «Сесія входу через ЕСОЗ застаріла. Почніть вхід ще раз.»; POST /auth/mobile/redeem {handle, state, code_verifier} -> session_token; errors keep `next_step` (sign-up offer, person-edit). Remove the old /auth/token exchange and the /auth/sign-in-error call (the server now resolves eHealth errors itself). Update/extend src/__tests__/auth.test.ts accordingly.
M2 Deep link handling: add src/app/+native-intent.tsx so simplexpis://auth/callback never navigates to an Unmatched Route (return null for non-initial, '/' for initial); on cold start (process died while the browser was open) if the app was opened with an auth/callback URL and a pending login is stored, finish the redemption (e.g. from the login screen via Linking.getInitialURL / a module in lib/auth). 
M3 Browser fallback (Huawei EMUI without Custom Tabs, devices without a browser): catch errors from openAuthSessionAsync and show a Ukrainian message (e.g. «Не вдалося відкрити браузер для входу в ЕСОЗ. Встановіть або увімкніть браузер і спробуйте ще раз.»), never raw English; handle the 'dismiss' result after the user returned via recents as LoginCancelled but if a pending login with a later callback arrives (M2) still complete it.
M4 Modals over the PIN lock (ТВ 2.9): create a SecureModal wrapper (renders RN <Modal> only while session status === 'unlocked' and covers its content when appState !== 'active') and replace every <Modal> usage (declarations.tsx, person-request.tsx, components/PersonForm.tsx, declaration-new.tsx, any other); remove presentation:'modal' from the kep-sign route in _layout.tsx so it stays under the lock overlay; kep-sign must stay usable.
M5 PIN: LockOverlay submit guard (`if (busy || pin.length < 4) return` + ref lock; onSubmitEditing must respect it); pin.ts verifyPin increments the failure counter BEFORE hashing/comparing and resets it on success, wipes at 5 failures; LockOverlay wrapped in KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView (keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled', centered content) so «Розблокувати» and «Вийти» stay reachable on small iPhones; add automaticallyAdjustKeyboardInsets + keyboardDismissMode='interactive' to ScrollViews of Screen (ui.tsx), auth-methods.tsx, declaration-new.tsx, person-request.tsx.
M6 Startup robustness: session.tsx startup IIFE in try/catch (on SecureStore/Keystore failure: wipeAll().catch(()=>{}) and status 'signedOut'); add .catch to fire-and-forget signOut() calls.
M7 iOS keychain survives uninstall: on first launch after install (marker file in the app document directory via expo-file-system, e.g. new File(Paths.document, '.installed')) run wipeAll() before reading SecureStore, then create the marker.
M8 Sensitive files: delete exported PDFs/TXT (lib/exportFiles.ts) after sharing and picked document copies after upload; clear the app cache directory in wipeLocal (logout/PIN wipe/account deletion).
M9 Deep-link parameters must not skip warnings: the 3.10.1.5 warning flag `warned` and the near-limit `left` value must not come from URL params (keep them in memory / router state); 3.10.1.5 warning must be shown before SIGNING a person request (also when resuming), not only before creating it.
M10 Double submit: ref locks (or the existing createExclusive() from lib/personRequests.ts) for person-edit submit, declaration-new choose/create, login/sign-up KEP buttons (no double requestSignature/push of /kep-sign), declaration decline/terminate/reject, apps revoke, auth-method add/approve/rename, account deletion.
M11 pin-setup screen: add «Вийти» (signOut) so the user is not stuck.
M12 Account deletion (App Store 5.1.1(v), Google Play): «Видалити обліковий запис» row in the More tab with a destructive confirmation explaining that the «Плексі» account and sessions on all devices are deleted and access to ЕСОЗ through the app is revoked while ЕСОЗ records stay; DELETE /account with body {"confirm":"DELETE"}; on success wipe local data and go to login with a message.
M13 Build configuration: add app.config.ts that takes app.json and sets extra.pisApiBase from process.env.PIS_API_BASE (default https://my-dev.simplex-med.com) and extra.store from process.env.PIS_STORE ('google' default, 'huawei', 'apple'); eas.json: development/preview -> my-dev (PreProd, used for NHSU testing), production + production-huawei -> https://my.simplex-med.com, add an iOS production profile/settings (autoIncrement buildNumber); app.json android.blockedPermissions add android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES and android.permission.DETECT_SCREEN_CAPTURE; ios: config.usesNonExemptEncryption=false, privacyManifests (NSPrivacyTracking false; NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes: UserDefaults CA92.1, FileTimestamp C617.1/0A2A.1/3B52.1, SystemBootTime 35F9.1, DiskSpace E174.1/85F4.1), infoPlist NSCameraUsageDescription defensive string (Ukrainian) in case the WKWebView file picker offers the camera; keep ios.bundleIdentifier ua.simplexmed.pis, supportsTablet false. Verify with `npx expo config --type public` and `npx expo config --type introspect` is NOT required (it may prebuild) — use public only.
M14 api.ts: request timeout with AbortController (90 s, longer than the BFF's 60 s eHealth timeout) and a Ukrainian timeout/network message; non-JSON responses handled.
M15 kep-sign.tsx: handle WebView onError/onHttpError/renderError and the page's {type:'error'} message (show it, allow retry/close).
M16 Declaration form modal: respect insets.bottom (buttons above home indicator / navigation bar).
M17 Logout warning (ТВ 3.7.1.1): logoutOnServer returns the server `warning` (Annex 1 text) and it is shown in an Alert after «Вийти з кабінету» and after the PIN-failure wipe.
M18 Profile (3.9.2.2/3.9.3.9/3.9.4.4): profile.tsx loads person, verification and auth methods independently (no Promise.all all-or-nothing) and shows the Annex 1 error per block.
M19 ТВ 3.11.2.1 item 3: «Усі відомості» always available on the declaration request screen (also when a form exists).
M20 ТВ 3.5.4.16a/3.5.4.19.d.i/3.5.4.15b: phone type selector from PHONE_TYPE (default MOBILE) for contact and emergency phones; country selector from COUNTRY (default UA) for the address — in lib/personForm.ts + components/PersonForm.tsx; prefill from existing data on person edit; update tests.
M21 ТВ 3.12.3.3/3.12.3.4.1: district selector in the address form using Districts by Region and Settlements by districts (see BACKEND API FACTS), resolving the chosen settlement to full data (type/district/id) via List of Cities By Search Params so the address has settlement_type and settlement_id; region search still works without a district.
M22 ТВ 3.11.2.2.1 / 3.10.2.2.1: whether the electronic form may be shown depends on `person` being present in the LIST response — pass that flag from the list screens to the detail screens (declarationFlow.ts toRequestRow drops person; person-request uses details.person) — fix both.
M23 Texts: keep \n paragraph breaks where the requirements break lines (MSG no-contract 3.11.1.7, 3.11.4.3, 3.9.4.2/3.9.4.3, verification messages from the server); 3.8.2.1 own-app revoke warning exactly «Доступ до функціональності Системи через цю ПІС буде припинено. Для продовження роботи буде потрібно повторно авторизуватися.»; upload message exactly «Завантажте копії ваших документів. До завантаження документів можливості особистого кабінету пацієнта будуть обмежені.» with formats separately (3.5.8.2.1, 3.9.3.5.f); auth method type labels from the AUTHENTICATION_METHOD dictionary (3.9.4.1) with local fallback; channel display PIS -> «Кабінет пацієнта (ПІС)», MIS -> «Медичний заклад (МІС)».
M24 ТВ 3.5.4.13 / 3.10.1.3.1: capacity document type options from /config legal_capacity_document_types when non-empty (intersect with DOCUMENT_TYPE; fall back to all non-identity types); for 14–17 the capacity document is one NOT in the registration (identity) types.
M25 ТВ 3.5.3: request the nonce (POST /auth/nonce) before showing the sign-up form; on error show the Annex 1 text.
M26 build-android.sh: build the AAB as well (bundleRelease) in addition to the APK, pass PIS_API_BASE/PIS_STORE through, and print checksums; keep resource limits and signing as is.

D1 nginx (deploy/nginx_my.simplex-med.com.conf and deploy/nginx_simplex-prod.conf): proxy ALL paths to the Flask/gunicorn upstream 127.0.0.1:3122 (so the app's security headers — CSP frame-ancestors, X-Frame-Options, COOP — apply to index.html and mobile-sign.html and /ehealth/return/* works) instead of serving web/ statically; client_max_body_size 21m (document copies up to 20 MB); proxy_read_timeout/proxy_send_timeout 130s (gunicorn timeout 120, eHealth 60); X-Forwarded-For set from $remote_addr and X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme; the site is behind Cloudflare (Server: cloudflare): restore the real client IP with the realip module (set_real_ip_from for every current Cloudflare IPv4/IPv6 range + real_ip_header CF-Connecting-IP) and clear any client-supplied CF-Connecting-IP when not from Cloudflare (the app now trusts only X-Forwarded-For from nginx); HTTP -> HTTPS redirect and TLS/HSTS settings sensible for Cloudflare Full (strict) with an origin certificate (keep paths as placeholders with comments if unknown); deny dotfiles.
